name: pixel-grid-fragcoord
prompt: Pixel-perfect checkerboard where each square is N actual pixels wide (an int parameter, default 8), with every 4th square highlighted.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a checkerboard shader where each square is exactly `uSquarePx` pixels wide. That's an int setting (default 8, range 1–256). Every 4th square along each row and column turns `uHighlight`, which forms diagonal stripes. I haven't compiled or rendered it because no Powermove tools were attached. I also couldn't confirm that the Inspector supports int `@param` settings; if it doesn't, the shader falls back to 1-px squares instead of failing.
